profile.headline: Software Engineer - Security Defense at PNC
profile.summary: As a Computer Science graduate, Splunk Architect, and a Security Engineer, I’m an enthusiast of all things puzzles and creative problem-solving. Armed with foundational technical knowledge, I’m always ready to face new emerging cyber challenges. In my free time, I love trying new things (kickboxing, drumming), expressing myself artistically, reading, and would never turn down an excuse to get coffee.

projects.title: Muching Made Easy
projects.description: A website designed to showcase different opportunities around the Burlington area. There are different pages, allowing users to select a location based on meal, which have phone numbers, addresses, hours, hyperlinks, and a google map of the location. There is also an overview providing more information of each location with price ratings and overall ratings. The Munch On tab is a form that can be filled out to keep users in contact with us (although not really being used for anything at the moment).

projects.title: Rasp Pi RC Tank
projects.description: A remote-controlled tank built from a Raspberry Pi. The tank was able to move around and be wireless thanks to an external power source. A webpage was created using a flask app and ajax to act as the user-interface which had the controls for moving the tank (coded in Python). There was also a page displaying feedback from a camera that was attached to the tank and controlled through a Linux terminal.
